content:
Apple today brought multiple major announcements for Mac, including the brand-new Mac Studio and Mac mini product lines.

If you're planning to get your hands on today's newly launched Apple products, you can currently pre-order through Amazon.

What's new today?

The following special report will briefly introduce the latest updates for the Mac Studio and Mac mini this time. Equipped with all-new chips (M6 and M5 Ultra), performance is faster, while offering more configuration options and a wealth of new AI optimisations.

  • Apple unveils brand-new Mac mini powered by M6 and M5 Pro chips
  • Apple announces brand-new Mac Studio powered by M5 Max and M5 Ultra
  • Apple launches next-generation Apple Silicon chips: M6 and M5 Ultra

Shop on Amazon

Following this morning's announcement, Amazon has already begun accepting orders for Apple's brand-new Mac mini and a range of new accessories.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Apple also made some minor changes to the Magic Keyboard today, with the new model already available on Amazon:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID $149
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad (Black) $199

Shop at Best Buy

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,599
